This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail, who is in jail since 18.10.2022 relating to FIR No.308/2023 registered at Police Station Bajariya District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences under sections 376-D of IPC and sections 5G/6 of the POCSO Act.
2.

Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that co-accused in the case namely Mahadev Rawat has been released on bail by this Court and case of applicant is similar to that of Ranjeet Dhiman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84617331/
1 co-accused.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Perused the order dated 01.09.2023, wherein it has been mentioned that prosecutrix has already been examined in the Court.
She has lodged an FIR against Ranjeet and thereafter second FIR has been lodged of rape against Rahul, who was quite living with her for some time.
In these circumstances, co- accused was released on bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that case of applicant is similar to that of co-accused namely Mahadev Rawat, without commenting on merits of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.

8. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumeration under Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
C.C. as per rules.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE pn Ranjeet Dhiman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84617331/
